extraction.notes: The official camp registration platform says the 2027 summer camp program is being planned, but does not list dates, prices, age bands, or registration milestones. Searches did not locate readable official 2026 session listings. The main site's 2027 workshop fees and scholarship deadlines apply to workshops with a minimum age of 18, not the youth camps; they have not been applied to these cards. The camp page and Jumbula platform returned no readable text when opened, although their official search results were readable.

cards.review_notes: The half-day format is described in historical camp publicity but was not confirmed in readable official 2026 or 2027 listings. Official youth-program information and Jumbula were read through search results. The general ages 3–17 on the youth page and 4–17 on Jumbula combine kids and teen offerings, so no separate program age range was assigned. Campus address is the provider's published contact address; specific studio drop-off locations are not listed.
